name: KutilXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables across three screens: Wave Bard on Bastl's open-source Kastle 2 DSP plus Kompas, Crust 2, Pizza, Alchemist, Basil and ABC. Tap a module to open a window with just its jacks, big and named, and patch between modules.
